title: Aurora
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Aurora is inspired by the story of the sunken city, Halfeti, submerged beneath the waters of the Euphrates, and by the legendary Black Rose that turns dark only in this unique land. In Roman mythology, Aurora is the Goddess of Dawn, and her name represents a deliberate contrast between darkness and light; for the deepest darkness comes just before daybreak. The past hidden in the depths of the Euphrates, the minaret rising above the water, and the noble black of the Halfeti rose come together in this scent, transforming beauty born from darkness into fragrance.

Pink Pepper, Mallow, Lily of the Valley

Nagarmotha, Black Rose, Ambrette

Patchouli (Indonesia), Oakmoss, Amber, Tahitian Vanilla

Aurora draws inspiration from the sunken city, Halfeti and the legendary Black Rose that blooms dark only on this soil. The fragile moment between Aurora, the Roman Goddess of Dawn, and the darkness.

Every rose loves the sun, but the rose of Halfeti loves the darkness. Aurora is the scent of secrets hidden in the depths of the Euphrates and the noblest shade of black.

title: Anemos
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Cappadocia is the work not of human hands, but of nature’s own sculpting. For millions of years, this land bowed to a single force alone: the Wind. Anemos — meaning “Wind” in Greek — takes its name from the Anemoi, the Wind Gods of antiquity. They were the invisible architects who blew from every corner of the sky, carving the rocks and carrying the seeds. And the wind’s most faithful companions are the Yılkı Horses, which have roamed these lands (Katpatuka — the Land of Beautiful Horses) freely since ancient times.

Bergamot (Italy), Pink Pepper, Elemi (Philippines), Grapefruit

Saffiano Leather, Geranium (Egypt), Davana, Nagarmotha

Praline, Cistus (Indonesia), Oakmoss, Agarwood, Ambrettolide

Anemos draws its inspiration from Cappadocia’s wind-shaped valleys and the freely-running Yılkı horses. A story of stones sculpted over millions of years by an invisible architect.

In the valleys, the wind whispers its own name to the stones. Anemos is the dust of wild horses, the warmth of volcanic stone, and the breath of absolute freedom.

title: Agora
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Agora is inspired by the ancient idea of “gathering,” a place where ideas, cultures, trade, and souls once came together. It captures Istanbul’s thousand-year-old cultural heritage, the spice-filled atmosphere of its bazaars, and the waters of the Golden Horn — known in antiquity as “Chrysokeras” — turning into gold at sunset.

Bergamot, Cardamom (Guatemala), Saffron, Black Pepper

Nagarmotha, Pimento Berry, Olibanum

Bourbon Vanilla, Cedarwood (Virginia), Vetiver (Haiti), Guaiacwood, Labdanum (Spain), Sandalwood, Praline

Agora takes its name from Istanbul’s millennia-old tradition of “gathering.” A story stretching from the gold-hued waters of the Golden Horn to the spices burning at the heart of the bazaar.

When the sun sets the Golden Horn ablaze, the water turns to gold. Agora is the scent of molten gold, of the Spice Bazaar, and of empire’s unfading splendor.

title: Clubs of Iris Reverie
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Iris opens with a powdery, velvety touch, subtly warmed by nutmeg and the creamy glow of ylang-ylang. Free from sharpness and haste, this beginning feels instantly familiar and comforting, leaving a trace that is cashmere-soft, calm, enveloping, and serene.

Iris, Nutmeg, Ylang Ylang

Karmaflor, Musk, Tonka, Mahonial

Mimosa, Cedarwood, Vanilla

A Soft Halo, Worn on Skin

This is a halo scent.

It doesn't announce itself, it hovers. Clubs of Iris Reverie is a fragrance of softness above all else. A calm presence that gently settles rather than asserts itself. It feels like a quiet breath, a moment of stillness, a soft light diffusing slowly over skin.

Perfectly balanced for every season

title: Heart of Rose Exotic
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

It opens with the energy of sun-ripened fruits and places the rose at the heart of an exotic journey. The elegance of Turkish rose intertwines with vibrant exotic fruits, while soft musks, benzoin, and the creamy warmth of white chocolate envelop the scent in the base. Warm yet refreshing, it remains in harmony with the skin throughout the day—a modern signature.

Turkish Rose, Passion Fruit, Mangosteen

Pear, Black Currant, Jackfruit, Paradisone, Nutmeg

Iris, Benjoin, White Chocolate, White Musk

The brightest expression of rose meets the vibrant energy of exotic fruits.

This scent tells the story of a rose passing through sun-warmed journeys. Joyful yet sophisticated. Refreshing yet seductive.Shaped by the vibrant energy of exotic fruits, it reveals a juicy, well-balanced, and modern character—sorbet-fresh, joyful, and an effortlessly wearable signature.

title: Châtelain 22
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

The fruit of a passion: Tonka bean… Always warm, mysterious and attractive.
The herbal freshness of hay, the soft warmth of tobacco.
The addictive creamy texture of vanilla.
Freshly roasted almonds and a powdery musk enveloping the skin.
All carefully selected to bring together the different faces of Tonka.

Clarysage, Almond

Rosewood, Hay, Tonka Bean

Vanilla, Tobacco, Musk

From The Streets to Scent, With The Enchanting Touch of Tonka Tean.

Châtelain 22 takes its name from the iconic Châtelain district in Brussels. The elegant spirit of the streets, urban sophistication, and timeless allure are captured in this creation.

At its heart lies the warm, mysterious, and inviting scent of tonka bean.

title: Marrakesh
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Marrakesh unfolds with a fresh burst of citrus, evolving into a soft blend of spicy and floral notes. Elegantly accompanied by lavender and jasmine, this composition gradually deepens into a warm embrace of amber and incense. This fragrance carries sophisticated freshness by day and a captivating mystery by night.

Petitgrain (Bitter Orange Leaf), Lemon, Cedar Leaf, Coriander

Lavender, Jasmine, Cumin

Amber, Patchouli, Cedarwood, Incense

Marrakesh; At the Heart of a Dream, a Sensual and Intense Experience.

Marrakesh, with its oriental spicy character, takes you on an inner journey. This multi-layered perfume, enriched at times with fresh and at times with gourmet touches, is part of a harmony that challenges the senses.

title: Musk Barrel
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

It begins with a spicy opening—warm notes of cumin, saffron, and black pepper envelop you in a striking first impression. Then, the soft floral elegance of jasmine and honeysuckle offers a romantic transition to the composition. In the depths, the warmth of amber, the earthy character of patchouli, and the noble scent of cedar and sandalwood linger for a long time on your skin, accompanied by musk.

Cumin, Saffron, Black Pepper

Jasmine, Honeysuckle

Amber, Patchouli, Atlas Cedar, Musk, Sandalwood

Musk Barrel; Mystical, Seductive, and Refined…

At every moment, you can trace the imprint of a different culture. For those who wish to leave a mark that is both sophisticated and powerful.

title: Vanity Oud
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

This unique perfume, with its floral and fruity essence notes carrying distinct layers, tells a different story in every moment.

Vanity Oud opens with sweet and vibrant fruits like lychee, plum, and raspberry. It then enriches with delicate florals such as jasmine, lotus flower, orchid, and frangipani. This floral heart gradually leads you into the impressive depth of vanilla, ambergris, cedarwood, and noble agarwood.

Lychee, Plum, Raspberry

Jasmine, Lotus Flower, Orchid, Frangipani

Vanilla, Ambergris, Agarwood, Cedarwood.

Layers of Mystery Woven into Elegance; Vanity Oud

It is a distinguished fragrance that appeals to free-spirited and sophisticated characters who enjoy surprises and feel like they are wearing several different perfumes at once.

title: Regularly Irregular
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

With a vibrant, energetic, and captivating opening that immediately makes itself felt, it intoxicates the senses. This fragrance, reaching the skin with the joyful union of pineapple, apple, raspberry, lemon, and bergamot, transforms life's chaos into a mesmerizing harmony.

The heart evolves with a zesty touch of Szechuan pepper, softened by delicate notes of rose and lily of the valley. Birch brings a smoky elegance, anchoring the scent in a deeper, more mysterious tone. The dry down reveals the forest soul of the fragrance—oakmoss, patchouli, ambroxan, amber, and white musk create a layered and long-lasting trail.

Pineapple, Apple, Raspberry, Lemon, Bergamot

Sichuan Pepper, Rose, Lilly of the Valley, Birch

Oakmoss, Patchouli, Ambroksan, Amber, White Musk

Regularly Irregular; A Beautiful Chaos

Regularly Irregular is a tribute to beautiful unpredictability: bold, passionate, and unforgettable.

title: Mystic
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Opening with the freshness of sage and bergamot, the composition takes shape in an aromatic heart of lavender and rosemary. But this is only the beginning. The base deepens with sandalwood, tonka bean, and white musk — evolving into an eternal allure with amber, gurjun balsam, and vanilla.

Cedar Leaf, Bergamot, Sage, Rosewood

Rosemary, Lavender

Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Agarwood (Oud), White Musk, Amber, Gurjun Balsam, Vanilla

The Celebration of Nobility; Mystic

It opens with a striking yet elegant presence that captivates you at first touch. The notes, merging like precious gems, carry the emotional traces of a noble heritage.

This unique blend, born from the harmony of noble notes, leaves its mark both on your skin and in your memory.

title: Antidote
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Top notes uniting the passion of red rose petals with geranium and nutmeg soften with the elegance of mimosa and jasmine, then drift into a sweet darkness with honey and clary sage in the base. Tobacco leaf, closing with vanilla, amber and musk, leaves a spellbinding scent on your skin that lingers through the night.

Geranium, Nutmeg, Red Rose Petals

Jasmine, Mimosa, Honey, Clary Sage

Tobacco Leaf, Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Patchouli

Antidote; The Unique Harmony of Contrasts

This unique harmony rises like an inner sun: simple and pure, fresh and radiant. Spicy and sweet aromas delicately awaken the senses of smell. Antidote creates a provocative dilemma of emotions – for some, a seductive obsession; for others, an irresistible challenge. But it always leaves a lasting impression.

title: Kashmeran
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

At the heart of the perfume, Turkish Rose absolute and Bulgarian rose essence unite the elegance of the East with the sophistication of the West, while the rich vanilla amber accord adds an addictive warmth to the composition.

Raspberry, Red Berries

Rose, Violet, Iris, Labdanum

Benzoin, Patchouli, Agarwood, Amber, Cotton Candy, Musk

A Silky Touch; Kashmeran

The oud wood, originating from Laos, begins its story yielding to rose extracts grown in Bulgaria and Turkey. This magnificent union meets with rich vanilla amber, transforming into a sophisticated composition that adds depth to the senses.

Kashmeran is luxurious and soft, just like the fabric it is named after.

title: Ceremony Flu
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

The fresh, lightly spicy touch of pink pepper and bergamot draws you into a warm determination. Combined with the warmth, the iris note evokes elegance with its dusty and refined character, reminiscent of a silky clothes.

This composition deepens with the earthy tones of teak wood, balanced by the soft white musk, floral touch of linden blossom.

Pink Pepper, Ambrette Seed, Bergamot

Iris, Teakwood, Linden Blossom, Powdery Notes

Musk, Ambroxan, Amber, Haitian Vetiver

Ceremony Flu: The Silent Power of Elegance

Ceremony Flu is a quiet yet striking fragrance experience that evokes the peace and purity within strength.

title: Ceremony Bold
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

The journey begins with a vibrant burst of mandarin and orange blossom—an uplifting and joyful opening that dances in the golden warmth of the sun.

The rich, earthy structure of oakmoss lends the fragrance a deep opulence, evoking the mysterious allure of ancient forests.

Tagette, Orange Blossom, Mandarin

Tuberose, Jasmine, Rose, Peach

Oakmoss, Labdanum, Patchouli

A Daring and Noble Signature; Ceremony Bold

Ceremony Bold is designed for those seeking a striking, powerful, and unforgettable signature.

Ceremony Bold, bold, confident, and for everyone who wants to be remembered—it’s not just an ordinary perfume; it’s a statement, an expression, and a memory.

title: Hazz
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Hazz opens with the freshness of citrus; the energetic touches of orange, lemon, and grapefruit bring vitality to your skin. In the heart notes, the creamy warmth of mimosa and tonka bean meet the characteristic depth of licorice root.

In the base notes, a sweet dream begins: the seductive effect of caramel and praline accords intensifies with vanilla bean absolute. The elegant structure of sandalwood balances this sweetness, leaving a lasting and sophisticated trail on your skin.

A sensory reflection of sweet pleasures... Hazz takes you back to the sweets of childhood memories, a pastel-toned sunset, and fragrances that bring happiness.

Orange, Lemon, Grapefruit

Mimosa, Tonka Bean, Licorice Root

Caramel, Praline, Vanilla Bean Absolute, Sandalwood

Hazz; like a sweet smile…

Warm and sweet notes, juicy fruits, and the dizzying allure of corn jasmine come together in this composition, inviting you into the magic of a sweet escape.

The unique harmony of citrus and vanilla caramel gains a gourmand depth with licorice root. Hazz, evoking the irresistible sweetness and vibrancy of lemon cheesecake, is a cheerful, elegant, and addictive sugar bomb.

title: Heart of Rose
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Oriental, Floral, Spicy, Fruity, and Gourmand. This design opens with a refreshing melon and the recently popular note of pineapple, creating a playful start. At its heart lies a majestic floral bouquet centered intensely around Turkish Rose. With a high concentration of Turkish Rose absolute, this perfume takes on a vibrant form, enriched by mouthwatering White Chocolate, Amber, Musk, Vetiver, and Patchouli. Get ready for a unique skin experience with this exceptional rose creation.

Orange, Pineapple, Watermelon

Coriander, Violet, Neroli, Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Lily, Turkish Rose

Patchouli Heart, White Chocolate, Amber, Musk, Vetiver

Unconventional and Game-Changing Rose Interpretation: Heart of Rose.

This perfume is a true masterpiece for those seeking a modern interpretation of the rose.

A seductive rose touch that elegantly plays on your skin.

title: Ceremony
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Ceremony presents a rich emotional journey where oriental florals and fruity notes dance in harmony. With its intense sillage and lasting presence, it is felt and remembered. Just like the ceremony it is named after, each spray carries a captivating elegance. This fragrance envelops you like morning light gliding through an enchanting garden, seducing your senses.

Bergamot, Orange Blossom, Pear

Tiare, Heliotrope, Jasmine, Gardenia, Tuberose, Ylang Ylang

Amber, Musk, Coconut, Vanilla, Patchouli

Spring Awakening; Ceremony

Ceremony offers a vibrant emotional journey where oriental floral and fruity notes dance harmoniously. With its intense sillage and lasting presence, it is not merely worn—it is felt and remembered. Much like the ceremony it’s named after, every spray carries an alluring elegance. This fragrance envelops you like morning light drifting through an enchanting garden, captivating your senses completely.

title: Diamond Of Velvet
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Peach, saffron, and green violet leaf absolute open the composition with a delicate freshness. In its heart, iris accord, heliotrope, osmanthus flower, and ginger blend together, evoking the culture of a unique heritage with oriental touches. As base notes, tonka bean, patchouli, ambrette seed oil, smoky birch tar, and styrax resin create a fascinating atmosphere, bringing a modern and distinctive breath to the classic leather accord. The result is an extremely long-lasting, high-sillage, and outstanding composition.

Peach, Orange Blossom, Saffron, Violet Leaf

Iris Flower, Heliotrope, Osmanthus, Jatamansi, Ginger

Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Ambrette Seed, Leather, Styrax Resin, Birch Tar

Diamond of Velvet: The Meeting of Elegance and Nobility in a Perfume

Diamond of Velvetis designed with an aristocratic spirit; with its longevity, projection, and sophisticated structure, it is a signature fragrance.

Wrap yourself in an effect as soft as velvet yet as sharp as a diamond.

title: Dem
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Dem was inspired by the elegance of tea and the rituals of the Ottoman hammam. Its opening notes of white tea, bergamot, neroli, and pink pepper come alive with hints of mate, green tea, black tea, and ginger. The essence concludes with patchouli, amber, and musk, reflecting a simple luxury drawn from nature.

White Tea, Bergamot, Neroli, Pink Pepper

Mate, Green Tea, Black Tea, Ginger

Patchouli, Ambrette Seed, White Musk

DEM: The Dance of Earthborn Purification on Your Skin

It’s time to indulge yourself with tea, an inseparable part of our tradition.

In this fragrance, where cleansing and relaxation turn into a delicate ritual, feel the harmony of earth, water, and tea on your skin. The clinking of porcelain cups and the soothing sound of water flowing from the nearby fountain onto the marble floor settle a sense of calm in your mind. Dem is the dance of purification from the earth on your skin…

title: Efil
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

In the top notes, it offers a refreshing and vibrant opening with Spanish lemon, Pink Lady apple, blackcurrant, and ozonic flowers. The heart notes deepen with Okka rose, red carnation, and lilac, while the base notes leave a warm, lasting, and emotional trail with musk, muscarome, amber, and red fruits.

Spanish Lemon, Pink Lady Apple, Blackcurrant, Ozonic Flowers

Rose Centifolia Influsion, Red Carnation, Lilac, Patchouli

Muscenone Musk, Muscarome, Ambergris, Red Berries

Efil; The Dizzying Scent of Pink Rose That Soothes Your Soul With Every Breath

When you lie down on the marble surface, your senses awaken to the essence of fresh rose petals carefully spread across the ground. The magical scent of the rose reaches from its own essence to your very essence.

EFİL transforms into the reflection of purification within you.

title: Hammam
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

The top notes greet you with a fresh start of white soap, bergamot, and ozonic accords. In the heart, eucalyptus, orange blossom, lavender, and geranium revive the peaceful aroma of a hammam. The base notes complete this sensory experience with cedarwood, Haitian vetiver, and steam accords.

Turkish White Soap, Bergamot, Ozonic Notes

Eucalyptus, Geranium, Orange Blossom, Lavender

Cedarwood, Haitian Vetiver, Steam Notes

Hammam: A Purification Ritual Inspired by Tradition

The warm water flowing over your skin, an aromatic atmosphere, and joyful, gentle laughter rising toward the dome…

HAMMAM; The irresistible pleasure of the scent of pure soap. The finest form of the art of cleanliness, adorned with unique essences. Every time it meets your skin, the cleansing sensation you experience will make you fall in love all over again and again…

title: Ala
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

At the top notes, the warm effect of cinnamon, cognac, and apricot blends with the spicy aroma of coriander and whiskey. In the heart, honey, geranium, rosemary, and Turkish rose rise with elegance. The base notes of tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin, labdanum, amber, and musk create the rich texture that forms Ala’s unforgettable signature.

Ala, whose every layer reveals the harmonious dance of amber and musk, is like a master calligrapher who writes your name on the paths you walk... Quiet yet unforgettable.

Cinnamon, Cognac, Apricot, Coriander, Whiskey

Honey, Geranium, Rosemary, Turkish Rose

Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Benzoin, Labdanum, Amber, Musk

A Fragrance Hidden Between the Lines of History

All scents inherited from history tell a story. Ala is one of those fragrances that writes this story. In the expansive scent memory of the Ottoman palaces, the amber and musk aroma—mixed by calligraphers into their ink—can still be sensed in some handwritten manuscripts today. Inspired by this subtle spirit of history, we created Ala, where amber and musk’s harmonious dance is felt in every note.

Ala is like a master calligrapher who inscribes your name along the paths you walk, leaving a quiet but unforgettable mark.

title: Meftun
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

A daring blend begins with the spark of cinnamon and coriander, followed by intoxicating notes of rum and cognac. The heart reveals a vivid bouquet of ginger, wormwood, red berries, birch leaves, and angelica seed—fresh, herbal, and luminous. Finally, the base unfolds into a deep, sensual trail of patchouli, incense, ambrette, musk, and sandalwood.
A rich, warm, and lingering composition—crafted for those who embrace power and presence.

Cinnamon, Coriander, Rum, Cognac

Ginger, Wormwood, Red Berries, Birch Leaf, Angelica Seed

Patchouli, Incense, Ambrette Musk, Sandalwood

A Tribute to Elegance and Passion, an Ode to the Hidden World of the Palace: Meftun

We followed the alluring and inviting sovereignty that walks with all its nobility through the corridors of the harem. Tefarig, known today as patchouli and one of the most used palace scents, has been reinterpreted by our master perfumers with aromas that reflect this passion.

Meftun, whose inspiration stems from a passion true to its name, reflects the theme of the harem in Ottoman palaces; a vibrant call echoing from the past.

title: Şah
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Şah is a bold and dignified fragrance, crafted to echo the legacy of respected leaders and sultans. It weaves together deep woody notes, warm resins, and spicy nuances into a majestic composition. The fragrance opens with powerful aromatic tones, then settles into a smoky, resinous heart, revealing layers of strength, elegance, and serenity.

Ozonic Notes, Mineral Notes

Turkish Rose, Nutmeg, Clove, Saffron, Geranium

Cambodian Oud, Patchouli, Cedarwood

Şah is the Scent of Legacy—Majestic, Commanding, Unforgettable.

We drew inspiration from the distinguished scents worn by ancient rulers, turning the fragrances that wrap around oud into one of the world’s most precious essences. By blending aromatic notes reminiscent of the earthy scent after rain, we created a fragrance worthy of the grandeur of noble leaders.

Şah tells a powerful and honorable story about our olfactory heritage, with a deep harmony of the most precious essences. With its oriental notes, it revives the glory and nobility of ancient leaders.

title: Hatır
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Hatır opens with the warm and intense aroma of freshly ground Turkish coffee. Then, the heart notes enrich the scent with the sweet softness of white chocolate and the golden shimmer of amber. As it settles into the base notes, a fresh yet deep warmth emerges, thanks to vanilla, tonka bean, vetiver, and leather accords.

Turkish Coffee, Galbanum, Ginger

Iris, Vetiver, White Chocolate

Caramel, Vanilla, Tonka Bean

A Scent That Stays in Memories: Hatır

As its name suggests, the Hatır fragrance welcomes you at first step with the unique aroma of Turkish coffee. As an elegant reflection of the saying “A cup of coffee is remembered for forty years,” this scent invites you to the past, to memories, and to moments of reflection.

title: Nazen
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Nazen is an elegant and captivating composition that carries the delicate aromas of hyacinth and white flowers. It expresses the vibrant energy of spring mornings, the gentle breeze blowing through palace gardens, and the pure awakening of nature through its scent.

Peach, Green Notes, Bergamot

Tuberose, Jasmine, Gardenia, Ylang Ylang, Lily

Coconut Butter, Vanilla, White Musk

Nazen Carries the Soul of Spring; Fresh, Elegant and Timeless…

When spring, known as the poet’s season, arrives, hyacinth flowers placed throughout the palace spread beautiful scents and announce the arrival of spring. Inspired by this fragrant heritage, Nazen carries the delicate aroma of hyacinths and white blossoms.

Nazen, an extremely captivating and noticeable fragrance, embodies the awakening of nature, the vibrant energy of spring, and the elegance of palace flowers.

title: Turkuaz
body_html:
Olfactory Notes

Turkuaz is an elegant fragrance journey that combines the tranquility of blue with the freshness of green, bringing vitality and calmness to your skin. The refreshing marine notes, ocean breeze, and soft aromatic accords create a free, clear, and rejuvenating experience as vast as the seas it is named after.

Turkuaz, despite its light and fresh character, is surprisingly long-lasting with a strong sillage. It lingers on your skin for hours, makes an impression wherever you go, and leaves behind an elegant trail.

Marine Notes, Ozonic Notes, Artemisia, Saffron

Seaweed, Blackcurrant, Turkish Rose

Ambroxan, Amber, Oakmoss

Timeless Freshness That Touches the Senses; Turkuaz

We traced the warm breeze of the turquoise color, named after the 'Turk' word and the Mediterranean shores, which is also reflected in the majestic architecture of the Ottoman palaces. In this fragrant journey where we blend the most beautiful shades of blue with the freshest notes of green, we created a color that can be felt by the senses.

With its refreshing energy, Turkuaz, which feels as free as the seas it is named after, represents the enchanting harmony of blue and green.
